features.title: Selenium bot: carga-express upload from status.csv
verification: Package scripts/carga-express-bot with POM pages and headed Chrome
Reads scripts/downloads/status.csv and writes uploadFileStatus COMPLETE|FAILED|USER_INPUT
Logs in with IBARRA_EMAIL/IBARRA_PASSWORD, uploads CSV+PDF, selects Empresa then Plantilla
Parks estaciones/patentes for user input with Windows notify and continues next row
Waits invoice AI on app-ai-cat-loader (not graph-loader), retries 3x, prefers hyphenated invoice number and highest-confidence chips
Invalid Paso 7 form or no transition triggers one full-row retry; second failure writes FAILED
Paso 8 validation differences and blocked row checks write FAILED and continue with the next row
Only FAILED and USER_INPUT rows are eligible; COMPLETE, blank, and IN_PROGRESS rows are skipped
Duplicate validation writes DUPLICATED, skips retries, and is excluded from future runs
Every execution prints a compact status summary with missing files and session errors
No artificial parked-tab limit; manual tabs remain open while other rows continue
Five consecutive provider failures temporarily skip that provider when an alternative is eligible; single-provider fallback continues
--local always uses http://localhost:4200 even if .env BASE_URL is production; ng serve must be up
